lines.cap: In 1962, America's top generals signed a plan to attack their own people. And blame it on Cuba. This one is not a theory.
lines.say: In 1962, America's top generals signed a plan to attack their own people. And blame it on Cuba. This one is not a theory.

lines.cap: Operation Northwoods. Signed by every member of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. America's most senior officers.
lines.say: Operation Northwoods. Signed by every member of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. America's most senior officers.

lines.cap: The goal? Give America an excuse to invade Cuba.
lines.say: The goal? Give America an excuse to invade Cuba.

lines.cap: Blow up an American ship and blame Cuba. Stage fake attacks in Florida. Even fake the shootdown of a passenger plane.
lines.say: Blow up an American ship and blame Cuba. Stage fake attacks in Florida. Even fake the shootdown of a passenger plane.

lines.cap: In March 1962, they sent it to the Secretary of Defense.
lines.say: In March 1962, they sent it to the Secretary of Defense.

lines.cap: President Kennedy's government said no. Months later, the top general behind it was moved to a job in Europe.
lines.say: President Kennedy's government said no. Months later, the top general behind it was moved to a job in Europe.

lines.cap: It stayed secret for thirty five years, until it was released in 1997.
lines.say: It stayed secret for thirty five years, until it was released in 1997.

lines.cap: So next time someone says, the government would never do that, hand them this folder.
